name: Chaochang BITCH Zhentan
source:
A visual novel that lean on making choice in the detective's mind. 

In this VN, your choice is drive by the visualize of the thinking process. You are controlling the feeling of the detective. Some of them come from what the detective saw, some are from other's words.

[From [url=https://gavinpit.itch.io/paranormal-bitch-detective]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这是一部围绕侦探内心的选择展开的视觉小说。

本作将思考过程以可视化方式呈现，推动你做出选择。你操控的是侦探的感受，其中有些源于侦探亲眼所见，有些则来自他人的话语。

[摘自[url=https://gavinpit.itch.io/paranormal-bitch-detective]itch.io[/url]]
